phase-2.prompt: Write a sentence describing the best candy in the world without using the words, "best", "very", and "really"

phase-5.question: Pick the best sentence about candy that describes the best candy in the world.

phase-6.instruction: Eliminate any player that writes a sentence that has either the word "really", "very", "best". Also elminate any player that wrote more than one sentence. Also eliminate any play that wrote a sentence describing something other than candy. Also eliminate any player that wrote a sentence that didn't describe candy in a positive way.
